builds.name: Ablaze Pillar of Flame ceiling
builds.summary: Seek the highest damage from Ablaze Pillar of Flame within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.goal: Seek the highest damage from Ablaze Pillar of Flame within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.hypothesis: W5 on Ablaze enemy is1.25*(255+0.7AP). AP and MR penetration strengthen the enlarged W impact. Deathcap multiplies AP; earned Seraph supplies mana and observed Awe AP. Zhonya/Banshee each add105AP. Void provides40% MR penetration; Shadowflame provides15 flat MR penetration and20% eligible low-health magic amplification. 30min Gathering Storm adaptive stats fixed; Absolute Focus requires ownerabove70%HP. First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

ceiling.finiteState: Benchmark game30min,level18,max target rank,no elixirs/dragons/unlisted allied buffs. Enemy3000maxHP,900currentHP,100armor,50MR,1500bonusHP before legal debuffs; record raw overkill separately. One prior legal Blaze application.

Same-patch practice/custom test with exact state: record Ablaze Pillar of Flame tooltip, observed AP/AD/HP/mana/resists, per-packet damage/protection and final targetHP. Compare one legal item swap at a time, separating setup damage, rune/item procs and ordinary attack. Verify raw helper/statFormula mappings and conditional multipliers before treating result as established.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The form loads the recorded target slot and any explicit benchmark overrides; other fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR). Adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.
failureConditions: The candidate loses the intended packet gain after real mitigation, charge restrictions, proc behavior or buff eligibility is measured.

tradeoffs: Six final items explicitly replace late-game boots; slower access/escape, extreme cost and setup dependence. Raw-number candidate sacrifices practical positioning and does not prove a global maximum.
Confidence: plausible. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.

kitEvidence.formula:
Brand creates a pillar of pure fire, dealing [75 / 120 / 165 / 210 / 255 + (0.7) × AP] magic damage.

Units that are Ablaze take [(75 / 120 / 165 / 210 / 255 + (0.7) × AP) × (1.25)] damage instead.
